_warning: Application-authored data. The `signs` block holds procedural approximations for catalog entries with no plausible ASL-LEX lemma; they are not reviewed ASL and must stay labelled experimental. The `augment` block layers app-authored values on top of licensed ASL-LEX descriptors and never replaces a phonological value.

_schema.signs: Full phonological descriptors, same shape as the ASL-LEX extract. Present only for ids that scripts/extract_asl_lex.py cannot map. `app_authored: true` marks them descriptor-free for the audit.

augment.nonmanual: browRaise / browFurrow / mouth / headShake in 0..1, optional head [pitch, yaw, roll] in radians. ASL-LEX codes no non-manual channel; these come from published ASL grammar.
augment.repeat_count: Integer cycle count when RepeatedMovement is 1.
augment.movement_size: Multiplier on the movement primitive amplitude.
augment.movement_axis: vertical | lateral | forward - constrains the primitive.
augment.hand_relation: on_palm | on_back | on_radial | on_tip | on_heel | on_wrist | crossed | tip_to_tip | beside. Derived from ASL-LEX MinorLocation where possible; listed here only when the surface name is not enough.
augment.carried: True when both hands move together as one contacted unit.
augment.orientation: Palm and finger direction at the start of the sign, as unit vectors in the normalised body frame. ASL-LEX does not code palm orientation, so this is authored; without it a sign falls back to a direction derived from its region and whether it travels off the body.
augment.orientation_end: Orientation at the end, for signs that rotate as they travel.
augment.orientation_note: Citation-form interpretation, source URL, and scope of an orientation override; not a claim of sign-language validation.

good_morning.mapping_note: Application-authored sequence: GOOD then MORNING. See asl_authored_motions.json.

thank_you.orientation_note: Palm starts inward at lips and tilts upward as fingers move toward the addressee; it does not flip to an outward-facing palm. Angles are an interpretation of the citation images, not motion capture. https://www.lifeprint.com/asl101/pages-signs/t/thankyou.htm

what.orientation_note: Open-5 two-handed WHAT/HUH variant in this record has palms upward. Does not apply to the index-on-palm lexical variant. https://www.lifeprint.com/asl101/pages-signs/w/what.htm

you.orientation_note: Citation indexing YOU: index forward; palm obliquely down/medial, not forward parallel to the index. Interpretation from Lifeprint YOU image. https://www.lifeprint.com/asl101/pages-signs/y/you.htm

book.orientation_note: Citation BOOK: palms initially face each other and open upward. Replaces the generic outward palm plus ulnar roll. Orientation only; repeated contact timing still needs a phase-authored clip. https://www.lifeprint.com/asl101/pages-signs/b/book.htm

more.orientation_note: Flattened O hands face each other while fingertips meet; generic neutral palms forward contradicted this. Orientation only; handshape/contact spacing need separate review. https://www.handspeak.com/word/1433/

must.orientation_note: Citation MUST uses a clawed index with palm down and downward wrist motion. Generic neutral palm forward was incorrect. Only the orientation is corrected here. https://www.handspeak.com/word/1449/

drink.orientation_note: Citation C-hand drinking gesture faces sideways toward the non-dominant side, not the dominant-side/outward direction produced by HeadAway plus the generic ulnar roll. Orientation only; cup tilt and mouth trajectory require authored phases. https://www.handspeak.com/word/627/

see.orientation_note: Citation SEE starts with the palm facing the signer and fingers at the eyes; travelling away does not imply an outward-facing palm. Preserve inward orientation; path and handshape transitions remain descriptor-generated. https://www.strongasl.com/american-sign-language-dictionary/words/see

better.orientation_note: Citation BETTER presents the palm inward as the hand leaves the chin/mouth, rather than turning outward merely because the second location is HeadAway. This fixes orientation only; the B-to-A handshape transition needs further authoring. https://www.lifeprint.com/asl101/pages-signs/b/better.htm

_orientation_rules.thumb_contact_head: anchors.orientationFor: one-handed open-thumb 5, unchanged flexion, Contact=1 at Forehead/Chin, no second location -> palm toward non-dominant side, fingers up. App-authored inference from the combined descriptors, not an ASL-LEX orientation annotation. Covers FATHER/MOTHER and matching morphemes of GRANDFATHER, MAN, PARENTS, WOMAN; excludes COLOR, HATE and MEMORIZE. Source: coordinator citation-form correction; https://www.lifeprint.com/asl101/pages-signs/p/parents.htm
